title_original: 세수추계위원회의 설치 및 운영에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 5 (Meetings)
(1) The chairperson shall convene meetings of the Committee and preside over them.
(2) A meeting of the Committee shall open with the attendance of a majority of its incumbent members and shall adopt resolutions with the affirmative vote of a majority of the members present.
(3) Where a Committee member is unable to attend a meeting for unavoidable reasons, a public official designated by that member may attend as a proxy and perform the member's duties.
(4) Where necessary to deliberate on an agenda item, the Committee may invite the heads of relevant administrative agencies, public institutions, other institutions or organizations, relevant public officials, or private-sector experts to attend a meeting and provide their opinions.
(5) Meetings of the Committee shall not be open to the public.
